item.title: It's Outside the Bathroom
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: No

Page Type: SCP Article

Genre (Optional): Horror

Page Layout (Optional): I think I'm going to do a description, and then exploration logs at the bottom, maybe…?

Elevator Pitch: It's about an apartment unit, and you would see this dark blob outside the window when you get up in the night to go to the washroom. And then you would start seeing it everywhere around the house. And the door would be locked. And you would become so scared that you would escape out of the window, where the dark blobs would gradually become more and more aware of your presence.

Central Narrative: None.

Hook/Attention-Grabber: I'm not that sure… I'll try and make it sound scary, maybe.

Additional Notes: So um… This is a really dumb and cliche idea. Please tell me if somebody had written about this before already

Thank you so much! (And thank you so much for reminding me about the format… Sorry about that.)
